chunks: That is the bounty of God; He gives it to whomever He wills. And God is the possessor of great bounty.

key_terms.فَضْلُ: Bounty or grace, specifically unmerited favor from God
key_terms.يُؤْتِيهِ: He gives it (referring to the bounty)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Fadl' in this verse and how does it relate to God's will?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Fadl Ilahi* (Divine Grace), illustrating that spiritual elevation and prophetic guidance are gifts of God's will rather than mere rewards for human effort. It serves as a reminder of God's boundless generosity (*Dhu al-Fadl al-Azim*), encouraging believers to seek His favor through humility and devotion rather than relying solely on their own merits.
